keys.name: VIZRA_SEARCH_MODE
keys.reason: NAME COLLISION, and the reason no service in this tree takes an env_file: vizra-search reads production|development here, while vizra-core reads off|managed|external from a key of the SAME NAME. A shared env file would hand search the string 'off', which its validator refuses. Set literally per service. Reported to the chair as a contract naming conflict.

keys.name: VIZRA_SEARCH_ADDR
keys.reason: in-network listen address. vizra-search is never published off-host in any shape.

escape_hatch_note: vizra-search declares none. Its development mode is selected by VIZRA_SEARCH_MODE, which this tree sets literally.
drift_ignore_note: Tokens the coarse literal scan found in AGENTS.md prose and in build tooling, none of which vizra-search reads as configuration. SEARCH_MODE is vizra-core's key, discussed in vizra-search's AGENTS.md; vizra-search reads VIZRA_SEARCH_MODE.
